latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Maker Free for Windows.
- Upload and edit video clips with simple instructions—no timeline dragging or export settings required.
- Cloud-based rendering: turn raw recordings into polished 1080p MP4 videos within 1-2 minutes.
- Automatically manages authentication, session creation, and render pipeline.
- Supports exports in multiple formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WEBM, GIF, MP3, and more).
- Handles video edits, exports, credit checks, and session state—all from chat prompts.
